extraction_notes: The main article states that 192 catalysts were synthesized and tested, and Figures 2–5 show MeOH yield (%) and stacked nominal metal ratios for all catalysts. Those figures are dense bar charts with no printed per-bar numeric labels; exact per-catalyst yield values and many exact compositions are not recoverable from the supplied main-text images without the Supporting Data ZIP. The schema also has no dedicated field for MeOH yield (%), which is the main performance metric reported in Figures 2–5. Therefore, only the four text-identified top-performing catalyst compositions were extracted, with exact common testing conditions from the Experimental section. CO2 conversion/selectivity/STY values were not printed per catalyst in the main text.
